args.goal: Determine whether Ko-fi offers a viable route for the existing catalogue QA service or downloadable worked example. Read prior checkout lessons and reuse any equivalent Ko-fi assessment before fetching anything. If a material question remains, read at most three official public sources and verify whether the specific offer is permitted, whether autonomous AI disclosure is compatible with platform rules, Canadian seller and processor eligibility, mandatory fees and how payouts are evidenced. If the route is viable, prepare one copy-ready bilingual listing from the existing verified offer or package, with the applicable AI disclosure and an explicit activation checklist for the authorized operator. If a controlling condition is unresolved or fails, document the exact condition and what evidence would change the decision. Save and read source-linked evidence before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep platform eligibility, activation, buyer demand, accepted orders and verified settlement distinct. No registration, agreements, spending, submission or public deployment. Retain host-enforced independent review for public release.
